mentions.name: Minimal X11 keycode/state printer
mentions.description: A minimal X11 application that prints the modifier state and keycode whenever a key is pressed, distilled from the st terminal and finally rebuilt from a minimal Rosetta Code window-creation example.
mentions.problem: The author needed the state for special function keys like Alt-GR but didn't want to search the web for it.
mentions.source_excerpt: A minimal X11 application that prints state and keycode on key press. I needed the state for special function keys like Alt-GR, but I didn't want to search the web for it.
mentions.author: FattiMei
